text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَخْشَ ٱللَّهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening connective that links the prior verdict to a new conditional rule

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following conditional particle that launches the whoever-frame

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens by carrying the verdict of 24:51 into a fresh conditional frame. Its attachment to {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) makes the transition compact: the ayah is not an isolated maxim, but a rule drawn out of the prior believer-response scene.

topics.headline: boundary into conditional rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 24:52 as both connected to 24:51 and newly generalized into a conditional rule.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction can coordinate or resume discourse, and the following conditional clause confirms that the linked material becomes a new condition-result unit.

topics.headline: compact fused launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the conjunction and conditional particle arriving as one compressed onset before the longer condition unfolds.
topics.reason: The proclitic form makes the boundary link and the universal condition visually and audibly contiguous.

words.gloss_range: generic conditional subject governing the full jussive protasis

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the result-particle plus demonstrative answer to the condition

words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) makes the ayah an open condition: any qualifying person can enter the frame, but the same singular subject must carry all three jussive verbs. The answer waits until {{ar:فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:fa-ulāʾika}}), where the open singular condition becomes a plural class of winners.

topics.headline: one agent through three jussives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps obedience, awe, and guarding under one continuous conditional subject rather than splitting them into separate exhortations.
topics.reason: The conditional particle governs the jussive chain, and later pro-dropped subjects remain tied to the same conditional subject.

topics.headline: open class restricted by answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a wide whoever-opening become a tightly identified winning group only after the whole condition is complete.
topics.reason: The singular conditional subject is semantically open, while the apodosis points back to condition-fulfillers as a plural identified class.

topics.headline: prior description generalized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believer description of 24:51 has become a portable legal-spiritual principle in 24:52.
topics.reason: The boundary shift from a described group in 24:51 to a conditional opener in 24:52 widens the referential field without detaching it from the prior verdict.

words.gloss_range: directed obedience or compliance under a conditional jussive frame
words.root_gloss_range: willingness, tractability, voluntary compliance, and capacity are in the broader root family; the local Form IV transitive frame selects directed obedience

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the divine name as the first direct object of obedience
His messenger as the conjoined second object of obedience

words.prose: {{ar:يُطِعِ}} ({{tr:yuṭiʿi}}) turns the pliancy field of {{ar:ط و ع}} ({{tr:ṭ-w-ʿ}}) into directed obedience, because the Form IV jussive governs {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) and {{ar:رَسُولَهُۥ}} ({{tr:rasūlahū}}) as one object frame. The word is conditional rather than imperative here, and it inherits the obedience formula of 24:51 while preparing the direct command reprise of 24:54.

topics.headline: Form IV directed compliance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees willingness narrowed into accountable obedience aimed at named authority, not a vague capacity or disposition.
topics.reason: The broader root includes willingness, volunteering, and capacity, but Form IV with explicit objects selects transitive obeying in this clause.

topics.headline: one verb governs both authorities
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that obedience to God and His messenger is one syntactic act rather than two detachable loyalties.
topics.reason: The direct-object attachment joins the divine name and messenger noun under the same verb, and the formula has cross-Quran support at 3:132, 4:69, and 33:71.

topics.headline: outward obedience starts the arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a progression from outward compliance to reverential awe and then to active self-guarding.
topics.reason: The imperfect jussive keeps the action inside the condition, and its first position begins the three-verb sequence.

topics.headline: tested obedience across passage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees claims of obedience in 24:47 and 24:51 become a tested conditional principle in 24:52 and a direct command in 24:54.
topics.reason: The same root and authority pair recur in the surrounding passage, but here the local mood is conditional rather than reported speech or imperative.

words.gloss_range: the proper divine name as direct object of obedience
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name derivation traditions include worship, devotion, refuge, and bewilderment pressures; locally the proper name marks the determinate authority obeyed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the obedience verb governing the divine name
the messenger object conjoined after the divine name

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) is the accusative object of {{ar:يُطِعِ}} ({{tr:yuṭiʿi}}), so obedience first terminates in the named divine authority. Its position before {{ar:رَسُولَهُۥ}} ({{tr:rasūlahū}}) ranks source before emissary while keeping both under one obedience act; the later repetition at word 9 prepares the final pronominal compression.

topics.headline: named authority object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees obedience aimed at a definite named authority, not at an abstract rule-system or generic divinity.
topics.reason: The noun is a proper divine name and the syntactically forced object of the obedience verb.

topics.headline: worship-name pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps worship and ultimate devotion pressure behind the name while the local grammar keeps the selected role as obedience object.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute can color the proper name's authority, but it does not replace the local accusative object role.

topics.headline: source before emissary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hierarchy and unity at once: God is named first, and the messenger is added under the same verb.
topics.reason: The sequence places the divine name before the conjoined messenger object while preserving one verbal governance frame.

topics.headline: authority pair tested nearby
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the object of obedience here with the same authority pair tested across 24:47, 24:48, 24:50, 24:51, and 24:54.
topics.reason: The repeated divine-name and messenger field is local to this passage and prepares the later pronoun without making word 4 pronominal.

words.gloss_range: object-coordinating conjunction joining the messenger to the divine object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first object joined to the messenger by this conjunction
the messenger noun joined as second object

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins {{ar:رَسُولَهُۥ}} ({{tr:rasūlahū}}) to {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) inside the same obedience frame. The small connector prevents the messenger clause from floating off as a new sentence and makes the second object part of one governed act.

topics.headline: messenger joined as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the messenger added as a second object of the same obedience, not as an independent authority clause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the messenger noun as conjoined to the divine object, both governed by the obedience verb.

topics.headline: light bound transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a light liaison from the first object to the second, matching the syntactic joining.
topics.reason: The phonetic payoff is modest but coherent with the particle's local coordinating function.

words.gloss_range: His messenger as definite conjoined object of obedience
words.root_gloss_range: sending, releasing, transmission, message, and messengerhood are in the root family; locally the noun selects the sent agent authorized by the possessive suffix

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the later self-guarding verb that receives the compressed divine pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:رَسُولَهُۥ}} ({{tr:rasūlahū}}) is obeyed syntactically as a conjoined object, but the suffix makes him God's messenger rather than an autonomous authority. The noun selects the sent agent, not merely an abstract message, and completes the public authority pair before the ayah narrows to divine awe and then the pronoun in {{ar:يَتَّقْهِ}} ({{tr:yattaqhi}}).

topics.headline: authorized conjoined object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the messenger obeyed in the same act while his authority remains defined by God's possession.
topics.reason: The word is accusative by coordination and definite through the attached suffix referring back to God.

topics.headline: sent agent selected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices obedience directed to the authorized transmitter, while broader message and sending senses remain subordinate.
topics.reason: The broader root includes message and sending, but the local concrete noun with suffix names the messenger-role.

topics.headline: public pair narrows inward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a movement from God-and-messenger obedience to God alone in awe and then to a divine object pronoun in self-guarding.
topics.reason: The sequence of objects moves from the public authority pair to a repeated divine name and finally to a suffixal object pronoun.

topics.headline: messenger test thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places the messenger object within the same 24:47-54 authority-test thread rather than treating it as a stray formula.
topics.reason: The surrounding passage repeatedly tests response to messenger authority, and the local noun fits that recognized transmission cluster.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the awe verb under the same condition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the conditional subject governing this coordinated verb
the awe verb added by this conjunction

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds {{ar:يَخْشَ}} ({{tr:yakhsha}}) under the same {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) condition. It lets awe interpret obedience, but it also keeps the second verb distinct, so interior reverence is added to outward compliance rather than swallowed by it.

topics.headline: awe added as second stage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears awe as a coordinated additional condition, not a loose comment or synonym for obedience.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates the second jussive verb with the first inside the conditional protasis.

topics.headline: fresh rhythmic onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the turn into awe as a fresh beat in the cumulative chain.
topics.reason: The repeated connector begins a new coordinated stage before the guttural awe verb.

words.gloss_range: reverential awe or fear before God within the conditional chain
words.root_gloss_range: fear marked by recognition, awe, and reverent perception; locally it is direct Form I awe toward the named divine object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the conditional subject governing this jussive verb
the named divine object of reverential awe
the following self-guarding verb that turns awe into protective discipline

words.prose: {{ar:يَخْشَ}} ({{tr:yakhsha}}) remains jussive under {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}), with the same conditional subject carried silently into the second verb. Its root field narrows fear into reverential awe before {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}), making the middle condition a hinge from outward obedience to the self-guarding of {{ar:يَتَّقْهِ}} ({{tr:yattaqhi}}); 35:28 supports the knowledge-colored resonance, while 24:55 contrasts a different fear-security field. The kh-sh cluster gives that inward turn a rough breath-and-hiss texture rather than leaving the sound payoff generic.

topics.headline: same subject under jussive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps awe inside the same conditional governance and assigned to the same whoever-agent.
topics.reason: The apocopated form and pro-dropped subject are both licensed by the earlier conditional particle.

topics.headline: knowledge-colored awe
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices awe as reverent recognition before God, not raw panic or self-conscious shame.
topics.reason: The root permits fear-language broadly, but the Form I verb with God as object and the 35:28 echo support reverential awe as the local pressure.

topics.headline: middle hinge to self-guarding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the condition move from perception before God into disciplined protective action.
topics.reason: The verb occupies the middle of the three-part chain and contrasts direct awe with the following reflexive guarding.

topics.headline: distinct fear field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes reverential awe in 24:52 from the fear-security sequence in 24:55 and hears the rough cluster reinforce the turn inward.
topics.reason: The same-surah contrast is concrete, and the phonetic observation supports rather than controls the lexical reading.

topics.headline: public scene interiorized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior arbitration scene become an unbounded inner condition of awe before God.
topics.reason: The local Form I verb excludes the shame-fear branch as the selected sense while preserving the passage movement from public response to interior condition.

words.gloss_range: the repeated divine name as direct object of reverential awe
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine-name pressure of worship and ultimate devotion; locally the name is the accusative object of the awe verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the awe verb governing this second divine-name object
the following verb where the divine referent is compressed into a pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) is repeated as the object of {{ar:يَخْشَ}} ({{tr:yakhsha}}), so the same named referent stands under a new relation: first obedience, now awe. The full name is not yet replaced by a pronoun; that delay makes the final suffix in {{ar:يَتَّقْهِ}} ({{tr:yattaqhi}}) feel like deliberate compression after full naming.

topics.headline: same name new relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same divine name move from object of obedience to object of awe, marking a relational shift inside the protasis.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the object of the awe verb, not a second object of the earlier obedience verb.

topics.headline: full name at awe center
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the full divine-name weight at the emotional center while local syntax keeps the role as object of awe.
topics.reason: The derivational and lexicalized-name pressure enriches the object but does not create a different local sense.

topics.headline: full naming before pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reference arc from named, to named again, to compressed pronoun at the final verb.
topics.reason: The second explicit name delays pronominalization until the final self-guarding verb.

topics.headline: recognized awe pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the direct pairing of God with reverential awe as a stable construction, not an incidental repetition.
topics.reason: Contextual profiles show the awe verb regularly taking explicit objects, and this instance directly governs the divine name.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the final self-guarding condition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the conditional particle governing the third jussive condition
the final self-guarding verb added by this conjunction

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds {{ar:يَتَّقْهِ}} ({{tr:yattaqhi}}) as the third jussive condition under {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}). The conjunction links awe and guarding without collapsing them, so the protasis closes with a further protective response rather than a restatement of fear.

topics.headline: final condition added
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears self-guarding as an additional final requirement, not merely an explanation of awe.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates the final jussive verb with the previous verb inside the conditional protasis.

topics.headline: cumulative step pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated connector as equal rhythmic steps through the condition chain.
topics.reason: The repeated conjunction before the second and third verbs supports the cumulative coordinated cadence.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII self-guarding toward the divine object pronoun under jussive governance
words.root_gloss_range: guarding, shielding, preserving, using protection, and related concrete extensions; locally Form VIII selects reflexive self-guarding in relation to God

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the attached divine object pronoun at the end of the verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَتَّقْهِ}} ({{tr:yattaqhi}}) is the densest closing word of the protasis: Form VIII turns the protection root {{ar:و ق ي}} ({{tr:w-q-y}}) into reflexive self-guarding, while the attached {{ar:هِ}} ({{tr:hi}}) is the divine object pronoun. The qiraat variants expose pressure around jussive mood and pronoun sound, including endings that lengthen or clip the final divine pronoun, but the local parse keeps this as the final coordinated condition that turns reverential awe into disciplined protection.

topics.headline: mood and pronoun pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this final word is a pressure point where conditional mood, conjunction value, and pronoun ending meet.
topics.reason: Accepted variants are relevant apparatus evidence, but they qualify rather than replace the canonical coordinated jussive parse.

topics.headline: agent and divine object compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one word hold both the hidden whoever-agent and the overt divine object pronoun.
topics.reason: The verb's agreement supplies the subject and the attached suffix is a syntactically forced object pronoun referring to God.

topics.headline: protective self-guarding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands taqwā here as active self-guarding before God, not a vague pious attitude.
topics.reason: The root's protective field is broad, but local Form VIII and the divine object select reflexive guarding in relation to God.

topics.headline: protasis closes on guarding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees self-guarding complete the suspended condition before the result particle arrives.
topics.reason: The verb is the last predicate before the result clause and converts awe into protective discipline.

topics.headline: variant ending acoustics
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears how variant endings can lengthen or clip the final divine pronoun at the protasis close.
topics.reason: The acoustic variants are meaningful for recitation pressure, while the local syntactic account remains governed by the canonical conditional frame.

topics.headline: portable self-discipline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the public legal-response scene become a portable condition of self-discipline before God.
topics.reason: The word connects the divine object and success field locally and echoes the taqwā category at 24:34 without tying the condition to a single venue.

words.gloss_range: result particle introducing the nominal apodosis of the condition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the conditional opener answered by this result particle
the demonstrative beginning the nominal answer

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge where the suspended {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) condition becomes consequence. Because the answer is nominal, the particle pivots from fulfilled requirements into a stable identification, and its fusion with {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) makes the result begin immediately.

topics.headline: condition answered by result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the suspended condition resolve into consequence exactly at this particle.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the apodosis of the conditional clause, especially before the nominal answer.

topics.headline: requirement to verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's architecture pivot from actions and dispositions into a stable result-class identification.
topics.reason: Everything before the particle belongs to the conditional protasis; everything after it is the nominal apodosis.

topics.headline: immediate fused result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 24:52 shifting from the appended endorsement pattern of 24:51 to a logical result pattern.
topics.reason: The result particle attaches directly to the demonstrative, and the connector contrasts with the 24:51 closure.

words.gloss_range: far demonstrative pointing back to the condition-fulfillers as a plural marked class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the singular conditional subject resumed as a plural demonstrative class

words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) points back to the singular {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) as a plural class: whoever fulfills the condition becomes those people. Its far-deictic form dignifies the just-described referents, and it begins the restrictive closure formula echoed from 24:51 while the predicate escalates.

topics.headline: whoever becomes those
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a generic singular condition produce a definite plural class of fulfillers.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is linked to the condition-fulfillers and converts the open conditional subject into a pointed plural group.

topics.headline: dignifying deictic distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the far demonstrative lifts the nearby referents into a marked, distinguished class.
topics.reason: The form is a far demonstrative even though its antecedent has just been described, giving deictic weight to the result onset.

topics.headline: restriction begins here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the result presented as identification of who the winners are, not as a narrated winning event.
topics.reason: The demonstrative begins the demonstrative-pronoun-definite predicate structure that has a restrictive identification effect.

topics.headline: 24:51 closure echoed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares the repeated closure shape of 24:51 and 24:52 while noticing the predicate shift.
topics.reason: The phrase shape repeats the prior ayah's demonstrative-pronoun opening while this ayah supplies a new predicate.

words.gloss_range: independent separating pronoun intensifying the nominal identification
words.prose: {{ar:هُمُ}} ({{tr:humu}}) stands as a full separating pronoun between demonstrative subject and definite predicate. It sharpens the sentence from description into restrictive identification: those, they, are the winners; the same slot also echoes the closure architecture of 24:51.

topics.headline: separator intensifies restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pronoun sharpen predication into exclusive identification rather than loose description.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun occupies the separating slot between demonstrative subject and definite predicate.

topics.headline: same verdict frame repeated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 24:52 carry forward the same result-clause frame from 24:51 while changing the outcome word.
topics.reason: The same pronoun appears in the same demonstrative-pronoun-predicate slot across the two adjacent verdict clauses.

words.gloss_range: the definite active participle naming the condition-fulfillers as the triumphant/winning class
words.root_gloss_range: winning good, escaping harm, safe arrival after danger, and related extensions; locally the definite active participle names enduring triumphant identity
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ}} ({{tr:al-fāʾizūna}}) closes the ayah as a definite active participle, so the result is not a one-time event but the identity of the triumphant ones. The {{ar:ف و ز}} ({{tr:f-w-z}}) field carries both escape from harm and attainment of good, including the safe-arrival image of crossing danger; in the 24:51-24:52 echo, flourishing language escalates into triumphant arrival. The word also stands without an added greatness qualifier, and the shared -ūna plural close binds it to the prior verdict while the hamza gives the final success word a threshold-like catch.

topics.headline: definite winner identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the result as enduring class identity, not a single completed winning event.
topics.reason: The noun is a definite active participle and the predicate of the nominal apodosis.

topics.headline: recognized restricted class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the winners as the recognized class produced by the condition, tightened by the definite predicate and separator pronoun.
topics.reason: The nominative definite predicate completes the demonstrative-pronoun structure with restrictive force.

topics.headline: safe arrival plus attainment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands triumph as both crossing out of danger and arriving at desired good, not merely abstract success.
topics.reason: The root family supplies escape and attainment imagery, while the local active participle keeps that pressure focused on the triumphant people.

topics.headline: agents hold triumph
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the people who embody the outcome, while causative granting of success is not foregrounded by this form.
topics.reason: The active participle is limited in occurrence compared with the common verbal noun, and the local form is not a causative success form.

topics.headline: chain lands on triumph
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees all prior conditions gathered into the final restricted result identity.
topics.reason: The final predicate receives the semantic and acoustic weight of the whole conditional chain.

topics.headline: 24:51 reward escalates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares 24:51 and 24:52 as adjacent verdicts where flourishing language shifts into triumphant safe-arrival language.
topics.reason: The same closure frame appears in adjacent ayahs, but the predicate root changes from flourishing/success to triumph/escape-attainment.

topics.headline: unqualified final force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the triumph word standing without a greatness qualifier, while its final sound carries a sharp threshold feel.
topics.reason: Frequent pairing with greatness language is background only; locally the active participle stands unqualified and closes the ayah.

topics.headline: plural ending binds closures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the plural ending bind the adjacent closures while the changed root differentiates the outcome.
topics.reason: The same plural ending echoes 24:51, and the low occurrence of this active participle form gives the final word agent-focused weight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated construction يُطِعِ ... وَيَخْشَ ... وَيَتَّقْهِ culminates in هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A transmitted demand is met by outward compliance, inward awe, and active self-protection; success is the result of all three operating together rather than of profession alone.

activation_trace.role: The compliance image supplies the outward yielding motion that begins the mechanism.
The worship and worshipped image identifies the twice-named divine center of both action and awe.
The message and its carrier supply the mediated channel through which compliance becomes concrete.
Awe-bearing fear supplies inward seriousness rather than mere external conformity.
Making oneself protected supplies sustained self-governance after the command is heard.
Attainment joined to escape from harm supplies the resulting sense of success.

changed_reading.before: The ayah promises success to people who obey and fear God.
changed_reading.after: The ayah defines winning as an integrated circuit: receive the divine message, yield in conduct, remain inwardly awed, and keep oneself guarded.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of يَخْشَ, يَتَّقْهِ, and فَآئِزُونَ links perceived danger, protection, and arrival.
baseline_models.mechanism: Awe detects the hazard, taqwa interposes protection, and fawz names safe passage through a potentially destructive expanse.

activation_trace.role: Fear with awe supplies awareness that the passage carries real stakes.
A barrier that repels harm supplies the protective equipment of the passage.
The wilderness poised between rescue and destruction turns winning into successful traversal.

changed_reading.before: Fawz is possession of a reward.
changed_reading.after: Fawz is also protected arrival: awe recognizes an exposed route and taqwa makes its traversal survivable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from messenger to خشية and تقوى permits a reception-knowledge-self-regulation reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: The carried message becomes known inwardly, the self is made tractable to it, and protective discipline converts that knowledge into a successful course.

activation_trace.role: The carried message supplies the information entering the reader's practical field.
The knowledge-by-metaphor image lets awe function as informed recognition of consequence.
The self-facilitation image supplies the inward easing that makes received direction practicable.
Self-placement in protection converts recognition into durable regulation.
Attainment and rescue supply the successful endpoint of informed self-government.

changed_reading.before: Obedience is an imposed act and خشية is only an emotion.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can describe informed self-government: a carried message is recognized, the self becomes tractable, and protective discipline makes the recognition effective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rumor sequence models corruption as a low-friction relay: a reversal of truth is group-supported, received from mouth to mouth, treated as light, diffused, and followed step by step. Focus-ayah awe and protection therefore become an epistemic barrier that interrupts transmission before speech turns into collective injury.

activation_trace.role: Reversal from a proper direction supplies the initial corruption of the informational path.
An encircling mutually supporting group supplies the social carrier of the reversed report.
Receiving and taking up speech supplies each handoff in the relay.
Ease and lightness supply the false low cost that allows harmful speech to travel.
Diffusion and spread supply the community-scale outcome of repeated relaying.
Tracking an effect step after step supplies the propagation rule behind the sequence.
Visible footprints supply the incremental units by which a harmful course becomes followable.
Knowledge-inflected awe supplies recognition that apparently light speech has grave consequence.
Protective interposition supplies the interruption that stops reception from becoming retransmission.

structural_cues: 24:11-16 moves from a fabricated report to oral reception, mouths, lack of knowledge, and mistaken lightness.
24:19-21 then names diffusion and repeated following, exposing a chain rather than an isolated utterance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversal, group support, speech handoff, diffusion, and followed steps. I infer that taqwa functions as an information-control barrier in this sequence. A live alternative is that the focus ayah resumes general piety without specifically carrying the rumor mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa protects an individual from unspecified wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa also guards a social information boundary: informed awe stops unverified speech from being received, normalized, and propagated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly implements protection as boundary management: entry waits for permission, denial produces retreat, sight is reduced, vulnerable openings are guarded, abstention is exercised, and coercive crossing is forbidden. Taqwa in the focus ayah becomes operational competence at thresholds rather than an unlocated inner state.

activation_trace.role: Movement into an interior supplies the threshold whose crossing must be governed.
Permission supplies the legitimate gate condition for crossing that threshold.
Return to the prior position supplies the required response when access is withheld.
Deliberate reduction supplies a controllable limit on visual reach.
Preserving inviolability supplies active custody of bodily and relational limits.
An exposed opening as a site of danger supplies the vulnerability that custody protects.
Holding back from what is improper supplies self-enforced restraint when a desired route is unavailable.
Forcing another into what is refused supplies the prohibited destruction of a personal boundary.
The protective barrier image gathers these local limits into the focus ayah's taqwa.

structural_cues: 24:27-33 moves across house, gaze, body, marriage, abstention, contract, and coercion as distinct governed thresholds.
24:58-60 returns to permission, exposed times, clothing, and restraint, showing a recurring boundary architecture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated rules for entry, visibility, bodily custody, retreat, and consent. I infer that these are concrete realizations of the focus ayah's protective verb. A live alternative is that the rules are separate legal applications while taqwa remains a broader motive.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is a general inward caution.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa is trained boundary practice: know the threshold, seek authorization, limit reach, guard exposure, retreat when refused, and never convert desire into coercion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The thirsty person's apparent acquisition collapses at contact: labor looks like water, supposition mismeasures it, finding yields nothing, and a complete account replaces imagined possession. Fawz is thereby tested as what is actually found and survives full reckoning.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work supplies the apparent asset whose outcome is being tested.
A water-like gleam supplies the false appearance of successful acquisition.
Supposition supplies the mistaken valuation that the later recurrence of reckoning corrects.
Thirst supplies the need that makes the false sign persuasive.
Actual finding supplies the contact test that separates appearance from presence.
Completion without deficit supplies the final accounting that replaces self-estimation.
Real attainment and rescue supply the focus criterion that the mirage scene sharpens.

structural_cues: 24:39 repeats finding and reckoning around the moment when apparent water becomes nothing.
The scene replaces the seeker's private estimate with an encounter and a complete account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies labor, mirage, thirst, failed finding, divine finding, and full reckoning. I infer that fawz means non-illusory attainment verified at encounter. A live alternative is that the mirage only describes failed works and does not define the later success term.

changed_reading.before: Winning is whatever appears to satisfy desire or looks like accumulated achievement.
changed_reading.after: Winning is attainment that remains real when reached and fully accounted for; apparent gain that vanishes at contact is not fawz.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate pre-focus sequence stress-tests obedience under adjudication: profession is followed by turning away, summons meets side-turning, and submission appears when the claim is favorable. The accepted response joins understanding to compliance regardless of advantage, then names flourishing just before the focus names fawz.

activation_trace.role: Claimed compliance supplies the profession that subsequent conduct tests.
Turning the back supplies the behavioral cancellation of the verbal claim.
Judgment between people supplies the concrete arena in which obedience is tested.
Side-turning and refusal supply the evasive response to an unfavorable forum.
Submission supplies the same compliant posture when self-interest predicts a favorable result.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies reception that proceeds into action.
Actual yielding supplies the accepted response without a favorable-outcome condition.
Success with continuance supplies the immediate semantic bridge from compliant hearing to the focus ayah's fawz.
Attainment and rescue consolidate the preceding flourishing into the focus verdict.

structural_cues: 24:47 places أَطَعْنَا before a later turning away.
24:48-49 contrasts refusal of judgment with eager submission when the right belongs to the claimant.
24:51 joins سَمِعْنَا and أَطَعْنَا, labels such responders successful, and is followed immediately by 24:52.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a profession-conduct contradiction and interest-dependent submission, followed by compliant hearing. I infer that 24:52 excludes selective obedience that waits to know who benefits. A live alternative is that the contrast is confined to formal adjudication rather than all commanded conduct.

changed_reading.before: Obedience is assent to divine authority in principle.
changed_reading.after: Obedience is non-selective acceptance of mediated judgment even before personal advantage is known; hearing is true only when it crosses into compliant action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, fear that God and the messenger might incline unjustly is grouped with heart-sickness, doubt, and wrongdoing. The focus then retains fear in a different form, خشية directed toward God, and couples it with self-protection. Awe is therefore not suspicious risk calculation about divine unfairness but lucid seriousness that corrects the self.

activation_trace.role: The heart supplies the interior site in which distrust is diagnosed.
Departure from health and balance supplies the diagnosis of distorted judgment.
Agitated doubt supplies the instability behind refusal.
Anticipatory dread supplies the self-protective suspicion that judgment may harm the claimant.
Inclination in judgment supplies the feared unfairness projected onto God and the messenger.
Withholding from the right supplies the reversal by which the suspicious party becomes the wrongdoer.
Awe-bearing fear supplies the corrected orientation retained by the focus ayah.
Self-placement in protection redirects vigilance toward one's own conduct rather than imagined divine bias.

structural_cues: 24:50 asks three escalating diagnostic questions and ends by relocating wrongdoing onto the suspicious refusers.
24:52 follows compliant hearing with a different fear-root and a reflexive protection verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies condemned fear of biased judgment and then praised خشية of God. I infer a deliberate reorientation from suspicion of the judge to vigilant correction of the self. A live alternative is that خوف and خشية are simply interchangeable fear terms with different immediate objects.

changed_reading.before: All religious fear is one anxious expectation of harm.
changed_reading.after: The ayah rejects fear that suspects divine unfairness and retains awe that makes the self accountable and guarded.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, strenuous oaths are refused in favor of recognizable obedience and known action. Responsibility is then apportioned as burdens, the messenger carries delivery, and the hearer reaches guidance by obeying. The focus ayah's winning conduct is ordinary, inspectable performance rather than verbal intensity.

activation_trace.role: The oath image supplies emphatic verbal commitment that is explicitly declined as proof.
Maximum effort under strain supplies the inflated intensity of the pledge.
Compliance supplies the requested substitute for oath performance.
Recognition by an observable mark supplies the public legibility required of obedience.
Intentional deed supplies the observable field against which the verbal claim is known.
Bearing an entrusted load supplies differentiated responsibility for messenger and hearer.
Gentle direction to the path supplies the result reached through obedience.
Delivery of the message supplies the messenger's bounded share of the process.
Focus compliance is strengthened as enacted and recognizable rather than merely asserted.

structural_cues: 24:53 places extreme oaths against the terse phrase طَاعَةٌ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ and closes with divine knowledge of deeds.
24:54 distributes what each party carries and links obedience to guidance while limiting the messenger to clear delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected oath intensity, recognizable obedience, known deeds, divided loads, and message delivery. I infer that reliable ordinary performance outranks spectacular assurance. A live alternative is that the oath contrast concerns only the promised act of going out.

changed_reading.before: Strong declarations can stand in for obedience.
changed_reading.after: Winning obedience is recognizable in repeated action: each party carries its assigned responsibility, and delivered guidance is answered by conduct rather than oath volume.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus promise renders success as a social transformation: succession and capacity stabilize a chosen obedient order, fear is replaced by security, worship excludes divided allegiance, and concrete communal practices seek mercy. Fawz expands from personal rescue to durable conditions in which protected obedience can be lived.

activation_trace.role: A promise that opens expectation supplies the projected future state of the mechanism.
One party coming after and standing in place of another supplies continuity across generations.
Capacity and establishment supply the stable ability to enact the accepted order.
Obedient submission supplies the character of the order being established.
One condition taking the place of another supplies the causal transition from fear to security.
Expected harm supplies the unstable condition to be displaced.
Settled trust and security supply both the people capable of the transition and its social outcome.
Humble worshipful obedience supplies the practice that prevents security from becoming mere domination.
Compliance supplies the communal action repeated after the promise.
Merciful tenderness supplies the hoped-for quality and result of the ordered practices.
Attainment with rescue supplies the focus term widened into collective security.

structural_cues: 24:55 explicitly replaces fear with security and places that transition inside succession, establishment, worship, and undivided allegiance.
24:56 follows with prayer, almsgiving, obedience to the messenger, and hoped-for mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a promised fear-to-security replacement followed by communal practices. I infer that this social stabilization is one temporal realization of fawz. A live alternative is that fawz remains primarily ultimate rescue while 24:55 describes a separate historical promise.

changed_reading.before: Winning is an unspecified individual reward.
changed_reading.after: Winning can include a collective conversion of fear into secure, merciful, non-coercive order sustained by worship and recognizable obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing collective scene distinguishes legitimate departure from successful-looking escape. A common matter gathers participants; a personal matter may justify leaving, but departure becomes sound through explicit permission. Quiet extraction under another's cover is exposed and warned as a route into trial. Fawz as escape is thus reversed: covert getting-away is not winning.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed parts supplies the integrity of the common undertaking.
Going away supplies the movement whose legitimacy is at issue.
Permission supplies the transparent gate by which private need and common duty are reconciled.
A person's concrete affair supplies a legitimate competing claim without dissolving the collective claim.
Gentle hidden extraction supplies the counterfeit form of successful departure.
Hiding behind another supplies the concealment technology of covert exit.
Alert precaution supplies the warning that the hidden route carries danger rather than safety.
Testing a person as metal supplies the exposing consequence of attempted concealment.
Escape across danger supplies the focus image that the closing scene ethically reclassifies.

structural_cues: 24:62 permits departure for a personal affair but repeats permission around that movement.
24:63 immediately contrasts this with people slipping away while using one another as cover.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered duty, private need, permitted departure, covert extraction, cover, and warning. I infer that the closing scene distinguishes true fawz from merely evading accountability. A live alternative is that the departure rules concern etiquette around the messenger without redefining success.

changed_reading.before: Winning may look like successfully escaping a burdensome collective demand.
changed_reading.after: Winning preserves integrity under shared obligation: a real need exits through permission, while unnoticed extraction under cover is a failed imitation of escape.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps ethical verbs onto lamp engineering. It remains anchored in خشية as knowledge, وقاية as an interposed protection, and فوز as passage, while 24:35 supplies a light held in a niche and transparent vessel. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for protected guidance, not as a lexical gloss of the focus words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَخْشَ ... وَيَتَّقْهِ ... ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ can be modeled as awareness, protective containment, and successful passage.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the guidance-bearing content that must remain available.
The lamp niche supplies a bounded housing that concentrates and protects light.
Transparent glass supplies protection that does not block transmission.
Ignition supplies the active energy that containment preserves rather than extinguishes.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies the practical work performed by protected light.
Knowledge-inflected awe supplies receptive awareness of the light's direction.
Protective interposition supplies the ethical analogue of niche and transparent vessel.
Passage through a dangerous expanse supplies the navigational need for protected light.

changed_reading.before: Protection blocks exposure, while guidance simply gives information.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa can resemble transparent containment: it shelters guidance without sealing it off, keeping enough light active for successful passage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hoof-protection branch of وقاية through the surah's creature-gaits and straight path. It remains anchored in يَتَّقْهِ and the wilderness branch of فوز, with contextual walking and guidance. Downstream prose should mark it as a cross-domain bodily analogy, not claim that the ayah literally concerns animal locomotion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَتَّقْهِ precedes فَآئِزُونَ, allowing protection of one's footing to mediate successful traversal.

activation_trace.role: Walking and bodily movement supply varied modes of negotiating terrain.
Gentle direction supplies orientation for movement rather than motion alone.
The straight road supplies the traversable line toward which movement is directed.
An animal protecting its hoof from rough ground supplies careful contact with hazardous terrain.
The dangerous wilderness supplies the larger route on which careful footing matters.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is static avoidance and fawz is a reward at the end.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa can be imagined as careful gait: guarded contact with rough ground lets a guided traveler keep moving until the dangerous route becomes a passage rather than a ruin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus's success root also carries a death-and-passing branch. It remains lexically anchored and the surah closes with destination, return, and disclosed deeds, but nothing in the packet makes death itself praiseworthy. Downstream prose should use it only to qualify worldly triumph with mortality and irreversible accounting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَآئِزُونَ carries a branch in which passing from the world shadows its ordinary rescue-and-attainment sense.

activation_trace.role: Becoming toward an outcome supplies the surah's explicit orientation to an eventual destination.
The repeated movement toward an outcome supplies a negative destination against which winning is measured.
Return to a prior source supplies the closing irreversible movement into disclosure.
Intentional deeds supply what is carried into the closing disclosure.
Death and passing supply the branch-distant reminder that no worldly success escapes the final passage.

changed_reading.before: The winners are simply those who secure favorable conditions within life.
changed_reading.after: The label of winners is shadowed by mortal passage: genuine success must survive return and disclosure, not merely prevail before them.

strongest_changes: The immediate 24:47-51 sequence turns obedience from profession into non-selective acceptance of judgment, joining compliant hearing to flourishing before 24:52 names fawz.
The surah's house, gaze, body, consent, and privacy rules make taqwa a concrete architecture of thresholds and protected openings.
The condemned fear of divine bias in 24:50 is reoriented in 24:52 into awe that scrutinizes and guards the self.
The mirage and closing permission scenes distinguish real attainment from two counterfeits: imagined possession and covert escape.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation made the short focus ayah a hinge among several repeated systems: speech can be relayed or responsibly heard, boundaries can be crossed or permission-governed, fear can become suspicion or self-vigilance, and apparent escape can become either accountable passage or concealed withdrawal.
remaining_uncertainties: The lamp-vessel and careful-gait readings are materially coherent but remain analogical rather than direct lexical claims.
The death branch of فوز is packet-licensed yet distant; the context supports final passage more securely than it supports reading death into the focus predicate.
The collective security promised after the focus may be a temporal realization of fawz or a distinct promise adjacent to an ultimately oriented success.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Winning is a guarded passage between peril and escape.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `ط و ع` B001 is willing obedience; `خ ش ي` B001 fear/reverent awe; `و ق ي` B002 placing the self in protective caution and B001 warding with a barrier; `ف و ز` B001 is winning good and escaping harm, while B003 is the desert passage poised between escape and peril. **Structural cue:** 24:47-51 contrast turning, self-interest, and responsive judgment; 24:53-54 test verbal oath against carried responsibility; 24:55 replaces fear with security, and 24:57 denies escape to rejecters. **Assigned role:** obedience gives direction, awe detects danger, protective caution regulates steps, and `فوز` names successful emergence from the hazardous passage. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies directional practices and opposed endpoints; I infer sustained guarded movement → escape plus attained good. **Reading change:** victory is not a static prize but safe transit produced by a coordinated disposition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 24:55's replacement of fear with security supplied the positive endpoint of the passage, while 24:57's denied escape supplied its negative mirror; together they made `فوز` both attainment and safe emergence.

baseline.text: Kim Allah'a ve elçisine itaat eder, Allah'a saygıyla korkar ve O'na karşı gelmekten sakınırsa başarıya ulaşanlar işte onlardır.

findings.text: Başarı durağan bir ödül değil; gönüllü itaatin yön verdiği, bilinçli korkunun tehlikeyi sezdiği ve sakınmanın adımları koruduğu riskli bir geçişten sağ çıkmaktır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A summons to judgment reveals whether professed orientation becomes embodied approach or reverses into withdrawal, doubt, and fear of bias.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Face-turning, separated flock, judicial slope, bodily disease, optical dimming, and understood hearing make response to judgment a directional and diagnostic event.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hearing Completes Itself in Action
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A summons reaches the ear, is understood and accepted, becomes obedience, and terminates in safety and attained good.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: auditory reception `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; hearing as comprehension and compliance `quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`; obedience `quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`; success and continuing good `quranic:root_001175:B005/m01`; deliverance and attainment `quranic:root_001186:B001/m01`; reverent fear `quranic:root_000413:B001/m01`; placing oneself behind a protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Hearing is complete only when reception passes through understanding into action. Obedience, protective caution, and reverent fear then produce two distinct outcomes: enduring flourishing and escape-with-attainment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P4 24:47-64] No Path Leaves the Owner's Reach
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Distributed human control remains inside encompassing possession and knowledge, so attempted escape ends in return, report, and a destination with no external refuge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Owned dependents and keys earlier in P4 activate latent sovereignty branches; open-earth flight, failed outrunning, desert ambiguity, shelter, fire, and return turn final accountability into a closed trajectory.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Failed Escape Finds Fire as Refuge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fugitives try to outrun reach across open earth, fail to produce an outside, and arrive at a shelter that is itself burning destination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: incapacity to accomplish an act `quranic:root_000985:B001/m01`; escaping or outrunning pursuit `quranic:root_000985:B002/m01`; lower open earth `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; joining a place that receives and shelters `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; burning fire `quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`; endpoint and final outcome `quranic:root_000897:B001/m01`; desert poised between deliverance and destruction `quranic:root_001186:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 24:52 `الْفَائِزُونَ`; 24:57 `لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ وَلَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The escape scene inverts the success sense active at 24:52. Open terrain appears to offer outrunning, but no external refuge exists; the receiving shelter is fire, and the traveled route terminates there. The desert branch preserves the sharp lexical boundary between deliverance and destruction.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, zorlamanın karşıtı olan isteyerek uyma ile bir emre, kişiye ya da yöneltmeye boyun eğme çekirdeğini açıkça destekler. Aynı çekirdek, dizgin, el, yular ve dil gibi kullanımlarda bir şeyin kolayca yönlendirilmesi ya da takip etmesi biçiminde nesnelere uygulanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin ya da şeyin zorlanmadan başka bir buyruğa, yöneltmeye veya idareye uyması ve onun ardından gitmesidir. Bu çekirdek, hayvanın dizgine kolay gelmesi ya da dilin bir söze yatkın gelmesi gibi kolay yönlendirilebilirlik durumlarına da uygulanır.

facets.statement: Bir taraf zorlamanın tersine isteyerek ya da direnç göstermeden başka bir yöneltmeye uyar.
Emre uyma, sözü dinleme ve verilen buyruğun gereğini yerine getirme bu çekirdeğin kişiyle ilgili gerçekleşmesidir.
At, deve, el altında bulunan şey veya dil gibi örneklerde anlam, kolay yönlenme ve yönetene tabi olma biçiminde görünür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, zorlamanın karşıtı olan isteyerek uyma ile bir kimseye veya buyruğa boyun eğme anlamında birleşir. Aynı ortak çizgi, dizgine gelen hayvan, el altında bulunan şey ve belli sözü söylemeye yatkın gelmeyen dil gibi örneklerde kolay yönlenme olarak açıklanır.

error_profile.preserves: Devekuşunun uzun boyunlu oluşunu ve örneklenen beden özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Boyun uzunluğu anlamının başka canlılara uygulanabilen genel kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal boynun yapısal uzunluğunu bildirir ve bakma ya da işitme amacı gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bakmak, işitmek veya bir şeyi gözetlemek amacıyla başı kaldırıp boynu uzatma eylemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: uzun boyun ile bakmak için boyun uzatma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda uzun ya da uzatılmış bir boyun görünüşü vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir beden özelliğidir; komşu dal ise belirli bir amaçla yapılan baş kaldırma ve boyun uzatma hareketidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnızca boynun uzunluk özelliğini merkeze alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yelken, gergin ip ve uzun mızrak gibi boyun dışındaki uzatılmış ya da kaldırılmış şeyleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: boyun uzunluğu ile uzatılmış yüksek şey
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal uzun ve yukarı doğru uzanan boyun görünüşünde kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın sınırı anatomik boyun uzunluğudur; komşu dal ise çeşitli nesnelerin gergin, uzun veya kaldırılmış olmasını daha geniş biçimde anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal boynun uzun olmasını, yön ya da hareket koşulu olmadan bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal boynun aşağı yöneltilmesini veya başla birlikte ileri uzatılmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da belirgin ve uzamış bir boyun duruşu görülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uzunluğu bir özellik olarak kodlar; komşu dal ise boynun yönünü ve duruşunu, kimi zaman yaratılıştan gelen bir eğim olarak kodlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilenler kalıcı boyun uzunluğunu amaçlı uzatma, yöneltme, genel uzamışlık ve boynun adı gibi en yakın sınırlarla karşılaştırır. Diğer adaylar farklı beden bölgeleri veya daha uzak sahnelerle ilgilidir.
branches.what_is_ar: السطع في طول العنق ورفع الرأس ومد العنق ووصف الظليم والنعامة والعنق السطعاء
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس سطوع الضوء ولا السطاع عمود البيت ولا السطاع السمة
branches.source_phrase_ar: السطع وهو طول العنق وظليم أسطع ونعامة سطعاء (maqayis)؛ السطع طول العنق نعامة سطعاء (sihah)؛ ظليم أسطع إذا كان عنقه طويلا والأنثى سطعاء وفي عنقه سطع أي طول (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi evin taşıyıcı direğini temel anlam olarak verir ve uzun deveyi bu direğe benzetilerek yapılan ikincil bir adlandırma olarak açıkça ayırır. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdek ile benzetmeli uzantı arasındaki bağı doğru kurar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, yapıyı taşıyan dik direktir; uzun deve yalnızca benzetmeli uzantıdır, boyundaki damga ise ayrı bir daldır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın ev direği anlamını temel alır ve kaynakta aynı dal içinde verilen uzun deve benzetmesini bağımlı bir uzantı olarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir evin yapısını taşıyan dik direktir. Uzun bir deve, bu direğe benzetilerek aynı adla anılabilir.

facets.statement: Evin yapısını taşıyan dik direklerden biridir.
Uzun bir deve, ev direğine benzetilerek bu adla nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar evin direğini ortak anlam olarak verir. Tahdhib, uzun devenin ev direğine benzetilerek aynı sözle anılmasını kaynak-özel bir benzetmeli uzantı olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın taşıyıcı yapı öğesini bildiren temel ve yalın anlamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Evin yapısını taşıyan dik direk olma çekirdeğini bütünüyle korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Direğin yapı içindeki destek görevini açık etmek gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Direğin eve ait olmasını ve yapıyı taşıma görevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Uzun bir devenin ev direğine benzetilerek nitelendiği özel bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Devenin uzunluğunu ve bu niteliğin direk benzetmesine dayandığını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yapı öğesi olan ev direğinin temel adlandırmasını yalnız başına karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal özellikle ev direğini ve ona dayanan uzun deve benzetmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ahşap, demir, ateş veya mermerden olabilen genel sütun ve destekleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir yapıyı ayakta tutan direk anlamında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ev direği bağlamında iki dal birbirine yaklaşır; odak dal yapıya ve benzetmeli deve kullanımına bağlıyken komşu dal malzeme ve yapı türü bakımından daha geniş bir sütun kavramıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal evin dik taşıyıcı direğini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal çadır ya da gölgelikte örtünün üzerine gerildiği yatay veya özel yerleştirilmiş sırığı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: dik ev direği ile çadır sırığı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal barınak yapısında kullanılan uzun ahşap destekleri anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği dik taşıyıcı ev direğidir; komşu dal örtüyü germeye yarayan çadır sırığına ve yatay desteğe uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ev direği anlamına ek olarak uzun deveye yönelik benzetmeli uzantı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel bir dikme veya sütun adı olarak verilir ve deve benzetmesi içermez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal dik duran ve yapıyı destekleyen direği adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yapı desteği bağlamında anlamlar yakındır; odak dal ev direğine özgülenir ve uzun deve benzetmesi geliştirirken komşu dal genel dikme adında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir yapı direğini, ayrıca ona benzetilen uzun devenin bütün görünüşünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal doğrudan boynun anatomik uzunluğunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: direğe benzetilen uzun deve ile uzun boyun
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal devenin ya da kuşun uzun ve dik görünüşüyle ilişki kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın temel anlamı cansız bir yapı öğesidir ve deve kullanımı benzetmelidir; komşu dal ise boyun uzunluğunu doğrudan bir beden özelliği olarak kodlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilenler genel sütun, dikme, çadır desteği ve uzunluk benzetmesiyle en yakın ayrımları verir. Kalan adaylar kuyu düzeneği, eyer parçası veya farklı destek türleri olarak daha uzaktır.
branches.what_is_ar: السطاع عمود البيت أو الخباء وما شبه به من البعير الطويل
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس سطوع الضوء ولا السمة في عنق البعير
branches.source_phrase_ar: السطاع عمود من عمد البيت (maqayis)؛ السطاع عمود البيت (sihah)؛ السطاع عمود من أعمدة البيت وللبعير الطويل سطاع تشبيها بسطاع البيت (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, devenin boynuna uzunlamasına konan damgayı ve bu damgayı taşıyan tekil ya da çoğul develeri açıkça bildirir. Verilen çerçeve hem damganın yönünü ve yerini hem de damgalanmış hayvan nitelemesini doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal boynun kendi uzunluğunu değil, boyun üzerinde uzunlamasına uzanan insan yapımı damgayı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, damganın yalın adını temel alır; damgayı taşıyan deveye ilişkin yapıya bağlı niteleme ayrı bir yüz olarak korunur ve genel bir boyun özelliğine dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir devenin boynuna uzunlamasına konan damgadır. Aynı anlam alanı, boynu bu biçimde damgalanmış tekil veya çoğul develeri niteleyen yapıları da kapsar.

facets.statement: Damga devenin boynunda ve boyun boyunca uzunlamasına yer alır.
Bu uzunlamasına boyun damgasını taşıyan deve ya da deve topluluğu ayrıca nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar damganın devenin boynunda bulunduğu, uzunlamasına uzandığı ve bu damgayı taşıyan devenin nitelenebildiği konusunda birleşir. Sihah erkek deve biçimini, Tahdhib ise dişi deve ve çoğul deve biçimlerini ayrıca tanıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Damganın taşıyıcısını, yerini ve yönünü birlikte vererek dalın tam çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Deveyi, boyun konumunu ve damganın uzunlamasına yönünü eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Damganın kendisi yerine bu damgayı taşıyan devenin nitelendiği cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Devenin boynunda uzunlamasına bir damga taşıması bilgisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Damganın bağımsız ad olarak kullanılabildiği yalın yüzü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Damganın boyundaki yönünü açıkça belirtmek gereken açıklayıcı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Damganın boyun boyunca uzunlamasına uzanması özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Taşıyıcının özellikle deve olduğu bilgisi sözün içinde açıkça belirtilmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal damganın boyunda uzunlamasına uzandığını zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal damganın yönünü zorunlu kılmaz ve devenin yürürken yana yönelmesi anlamını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: uzunlamasına boyun damgası ile boyun damgası
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal devenin boynundaki bir damgayı adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Boyun damgası bağlamında anlamlar yakındır; odak dal uzunlamasına yönle sınırlıyken komşu dal yönü belirtmez ve ayrıca yürüyüş davranışına uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak damga boyunda ve uzunlamasına yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu damga uylukta ve enine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: boyunda uzunlamasına damga ile uylukta enine damga
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal develeri ayırt etmek için kullanılan uzun bir damgayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Damganın hem yeri hem yönü ayrıdır: odak dal boyun boyunca uzanırken komşu dal uyluk üzerinde enine yerleşir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal devenin boynundaki uzunlamasına damgaya özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yara izi, iz veya develeri ayıran genel çizgi ve damga anlamlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel boyun damgası ile genel iz
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bedende kalan ayırt edici bir çizgi ya da damga alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yer, yön ve taşıyıcı bakımından dar biçimde belirlenmiştir; komşu dal doğal yara izini ve daha genel ayırt edici işaretleri de içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal boyna sonradan konan uzunlamasına damgayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal boynun kendi yapısal uzunluğunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: boyundaki uzun damga ile uzun boyun
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal boyun ve uzunluk görünüşüyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedene eklenmiş bir işaretin yönünü anlatır; komşu dal ise boynun doğuştan ya da yapısal uzunluğunu anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilenler boyun damgasının yönünü, yerini ve doğal boyun uzunluğundan farkını en iyi gösterir. Öteki damga adayları farklı beden bölgeleri veya farklı işaretleme yöntemleri nedeniyle daha uzaktır.
branches.what_is_ar: السطاع السمة الممتدة بالطول في عنق البعير والإبل المسطعة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست السمة العرضية العلاط ولا طول العنق نفسه
branches.source_phrase_ar: السطاع سمة في عنق البعير بالطول يقال بعير مسطع (sihah)؛ السطاع من سمات الإبل في العنق بالطول وناقة مسطوعة وإبل مسطعة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeye avuç içiyle veya parmakla vurma eylemini ve bu vuruşla çıkan yükselmiş sesi birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi aracı, eylemi ve işitilen sonucu birbirine karıştırmadan aynı anlam alanında tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal el ya da parmakla yapılan vuruş ve onun sesidir; ışığın yükselmesi veya boyun uzunluğu değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın hem avuç ya da parmakla vurma eylemini hem de bu vuruşun işitilen sesini kapsar; başka araçlarla vurma anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeye avuç içiyle veya parmakla vurma ve bu vuruşun çıkardığı belirgin sestir. Eylem ile işitilen sonuç aynı dalda ayrı yüzler olarak korunur.

facets.statement: Bir şeye avuç içiyle veya parmakla vurulur.
Yapılan vuruş belirgin ve yükselen bir ses çıkarır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, vuruş sırasında çıkan belirgin sese dayanır. Tahdhib vuruş eylemini avuç içi veya parmakla yapılması bakımından sınırlar; Maqayis ise vuruş sonucunda sesin yükselmesini özellikle öne çıkarır.

concept_gloss.text: avuç ya da parmak vuruşu ve sesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Vuruşun aracını, eylemini ve işitilen sonucunu birlikte vererek dalın iki çekirdek yüzünü karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Avuç veya parmakla vurmayı ve bu vuruşun sesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün vuruş eylemini bildirdiği cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Vurmanın avuç içiyle veya parmakla yapılması koşulunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Vuruşun işitilen ve yükselen sesini adlandıran yüzü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün eylemden çok vuruş sırasında çıkan sesi bildirdiği cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Vuruşun işitilen sesini açık ve doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Vuruşun avuç içiyle veya parmakla yapılması ve eylemin kendisi belirtilmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeye avuç içiyle veya parmakla vurma

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal vuruşu avuç içi veya parmakla sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yağmur, toynak, demir ve her türlü şiddetli düşüşten doğan sesleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: el vuruşu sesi ile genel çarpma sesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir darbenin kendisini veya işitilen sesini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal el ya da parmakla yapılan belirli vuruşa bağlıdır; komşu dal araç ve kaynak bakımından daha geniş, çoğu kez şiddetli çarpma ve düşme seslerini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal hedefi sınırlamaz ve parmakla vurmayı da kapsar; ayrıca çıkan sesi adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal elin özellikle enseye yerleştirilerek vurulmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: avuç veya parmak vuruşu ile enseye el vurma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal elde yapılan doğrudan bir vuruşta kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kullanılan el bölümü ve ses sonucuyla belirlenir; komşu dal ise hedef olarak enseyi ve elin oraya oturtulmasını öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal avuç ya da parmak aracını ve vuruş sesini kodlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kullanılan aracı belirtmeden özellikle yüze vurmayı kodlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişiye veya şeye vurma alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aracın el ya da parmak olması ve ses sonucuyla sınırlanır; komşu dal ise hedef bölgeyi yüz olarak belirler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal çıplak avuç içi veya parmakla vurmayı ve sesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hurma dalı ya da sopa gibi bir araçla vurmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir nesneye darbe uygulama eylemini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğrudan el temasına dayanır; komşu dal ise elde tutulan ayrı bir vurma aracını zorunlu kılar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilenler ses kapsamı, hedef bölge ve vurma aracı bakımından en yararlı sınırları verir. Kalanlar ayakla vurma, özel çubuklar veya yalnızca el anatomisi üzerinden daha uzak karşılaştırmalardır.
branches.what_is_ar: السطع ضرب الشيء بالراحة أو الإصبع وصوت الضربة إذا ارتفع
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس سطوع الضوء ولا طول العنق
branches.source_phrase_ar: السطع ارتفاع صوت الشيء إذا ضربت عليه شيئا يقال سطعة (maqayis)؛ السطع أن تسطع شيئا براحتك أو بإصبعك ضربا وسمعت لضربته سطعا يعني صوت الضربة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözün belirli tek bir dağın özel adı olduğunu açıkça bildirir. Dal çerçevesi bu yer adı kullanımını ev direği ve boyun damgası anlamlarından doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca belirli bir dağın özel adıdır; aynı biçimdeki cins adları ve öteki yer adlarıyla birleştirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimin belirli bir dağa ad oluşuyla sınırlıdır; adın yüzey biçimi uydurulmaz ve genel bir dağ türü anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli tek bir dağı adlandıran özel yer adıdır; dağ türünü ya da herhangi bir dağı bildiren ortak ad değildir.

facets.statement: Söz, belirli tek bir dağın özel adı olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu kullanımın belirli bir dağı adlandıran özel yer adı olduğu konusunda birleşir. Anlam, dağın niteliğini betimlemez ve herhangi bir dağa uygulanabilen genel bir ad oluşturmaz; Maqayis bu adı Huzeyl şiirindeki kullanımla ayrıca tanıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın tek bir coğrafi varlığı adlandıran özel ad işlevini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli tek bir dağı adlandırma ve özel ad olma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özel adın yüzey biçimini vermeden işlevini açıklamak gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir coğrafi yükseltiyi adlandıran yer adı işlevini korur.
error_profile.adds: Belirli tek dağla sınırlı oluşu gevşeterek herhangi bir dağ adını düşündürebilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; her biri başka bir dağ, vadi, yer, topluluk veya gün adını bildirir ve odak adın hangi dağı gösterdiğini açıklamaz. Bu nedenle yararlı bir anlam sınırı kuran komşu yayımlanmamıştır.
branches.what_is_ar: السطاع إذا كان علما لجبل بعينه
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس السطاع عمود البيت ولا السمة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أما السطاع في شعر هذيل فهو جبل بعينه (maqayis)؛ السطاع اسم جبل بعينه (tahdhib)

root_profile.summary: Kök; havada uzama, yükselme veya yayılma; boyun uzunluğu; ev direği ve ona dayalı uzun deve benzetmesi; deve boynundaki uzunlamasına damga; avuç ya da parmak vuruşu ve sesi; ayrıca belirli bir dağın özel adı olmak üzere altı dalda örgütlenir. Uzunluk ve yükselme düşüncesi bazı dalları birbirine bağlarken vuruş ile yer adı daha ayrı anlam merkezleri oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.
